description: The expectedSurface field records the pinned JavaScript g2pK port output used by practical-mode parity tests. normativeSurface is a separate NIKL comparator: normativeEvidenceStatus distinguishes directly attested examples from rule-derived candidates that still need lexical adjudication. This fixture is not an independent IPA gold set; practical mode must never replace port output with normativeSurface.
